items.caption:
Introducing one of Egypt’s finest healthy-F&B and brand-marketing entrepreneurs, Karim Samir, Co-Founder and VP Marketing at Benefit Company for Healthy Food and Beverage, creators of V7 and V Super Soda.

Karim is a distinguished marketing executive and entrepreneur whose career reflects consistency, creativity, and a deep commitment to building brands that respond to evolving consumer lifestyles. As Co-Founder and VP Marketing at Benefit Company, he has played a significant role in developing and positioning healthy food and beverage products in the Egyptian market. Alongside this role, he is Founder and CEO of Range Egypt, a full-service marketing and strategy agency that creates tailored communication, management, and creative solutions to support business growth.

Over the years, Karim has built his leadership around a strong understanding of brand strategy, consumer marketing, and commercial communication. Before launching his own ventures, he spent more than 11 years at The Coca-Cola Company, progressing from Franchise Assistant Brand Manager to Brand Manager, Senior Brand Manager, and Marketing Manager. This experience gave him deep exposure to portfolio management, consumer insights, product positioning, and large-scale FMCG marketing. Through his work, he has connected innovative products with consumer needs, strengthened brand identities, and supported businesses with marketing strategies that turn ideas into scalable commercial opportunities.

His professional path also reflects the importance of leadership grounded in vision and discipline. With a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing and International Business from Middlesex University, Karim combines international academic preparation with extensive hands-on experience across global FMCG and entrepreneurial environments. By moving from leading brands at Coca-Cola to founding Range Egypt and co-building V7 and V Super Soda, he has demonstrated that leadership is not only about creating campaigns, but also about identifying market opportunities, building meaningful brands, solving real consumer challenges, and developing businesses that can adapt and thrive in changing markets.
